public_rationale: OpenAI's own launch disclosure acknowledges that Deep Research could hallucinate facts and make incorrect inferences. limitations: Supports the existence of both error classes, not any particular frequency or severity.
Does not independently validate the tariff-paper or temporal-reasoning examples.
Does not establish Marcus's claim of predictive priority.

The claim does not specify an error rate or say that the system was useless or worse than its predecessors.
The target period is its launch week through the post date, the latest public observation period available when Marcus wrote.
This assessment concerns the stated remaining limitations, not Marcus's separate claim to prior foresight.
